title: Harden Memes v3 with prospective truth, executable outcomes and entity-aware research
objective: Implement the smallest research-only hardening layer required by the 2026-09-11 adjudication. Reuse the existing Memes v3 workstream and microcap contract. Add immutable point-in-time discovery state with field-level provenance and available_at/computed_at, durable prospective cohort follow-up and graveyard semantics, a Rejection Ledger/matched-failure binding, deterministic load-bearing unit conversion tests, executable-return/capacity outcome contracts, conservative entity-graph evidence with service-address exclusions, and visibility/crowding capture. Shadow-label Early Confirmation, conditional wallet skill and First Distribution state only after those foundations exist. Do not create a new engine, public watchlist, trade signal, sizing rule, model-weight authority or budget change.

scope: point-in-time snapshot contract v2 with exact chain+CA/mint hard key
field-level provenance, observed_at, available_at, computed_at, source latency and missingness
prospective cohort re-query/checkpoint support preserving NOT_RETURNED as outcome
durable census/graveyard and Rejection Ledger semantics
deterministic tests forbidding model-mediated epoch/decimal/unit conversion
executable-return/capacity contract with venue-specific fees, quote asset, liquidity and latency metadata
conservative entity graph with STRONG/MEDIUM/WEAK/UNRELIABLE evidence edges and CEX/router/service exclusions
cluster-adjusted counts without awarding safety for missing cluster evidence
visibility/crowding fields including public surface, first-visible timestamp and estimated follower-notional/executable-depth pressure
Early Confirmation entry taxonomy as versioned shadow labels
conditional wallet as-of scoring with future-outcome leakage forbidden
First Distribution state machine with reclaim retained strictly as outcome
entity-adjusted structure and Organic Capital Acceleration component experiments
Narrative Instance predictive scoring until registry/sample is sufficient
cross-chain predictive weights until matched narrative sample is sufficient
social propagation scoring until continuous source-lineage capture is trustworthy

allowed_change_scope: Donh91/Investering-Framework-Archive-v1:.github/workflows/memes-alpha-research*.yml only when required for existing research cadence/checkpoints and after existing high-impact safepoint/recovery governance

evidence.summary: Owner-approved research adjudication freezes the canonical methodology, rejected shortcuts, shadow hypotheses and implementation ordering.
Private prospective packet contains the frozen 2026-09-11T02:20Z cohort and source-integrity manifest.

positive: A discovery row cannot be mutated after freeze; later outcomes append through a separate observation relation.
Exact chain plus CA/mint is the primary identity key and same-ticker siblings remain distinct.
Every load-bearing field exposes observed_at/available_at/computed_at and deterministic provenance.
Epoch, decimals and token-unit conversion tests run without an LLM and fail on unit mismatch.
The 2026-09-11T02:20Z cohort can be re-queried at +24h/+7d/+30d/+60d while preserving every original row and recording NOT_RETURNED rather than deleting it.
Rejection Ledger rows are outcome-tracked with the same minimum outcome schema as accepted discoveries.
Matched controls bind chain, venue, launch period, token age, liquidity band and size/FDV band where available.
Executable-return outcome schema distinguishes chart return from executable return and carries position notional, deepest executable pool, fees, impact, latency and EXIT_NOT_EXECUTABLE explicitly.
Entity graph never merges on shared CEX/router/service evidence alone; edge evidence and confidence remain inspectable.
Raw buyer/holder counts retain cluster-adjusted twins and no missing cluster relation produces a SAFE/CLEAN bonus.
Visibility/capacity stores public-surface exposure and capital-pressure inputs without hard-coding the CDAS 6/10 follower examples.
Early Confirmation, wallet skill and First Distribution outputs remain SHADOW research labels and cannot emit trades.
negative: A future wallet win cannot change the as-of wallet feature for an older discovery.
Ticker equality cannot merge two exact instances.
Raw top-10, raw holder count, raw volume, raw mention count or a vendor smart-wallet label cannot independently promote a research case.
No implementation may interpret no detected cluster as proof of independence.
Candle ATH cannot substitute for executable outcome.
A MemeTrans-trained result cannot be labelled pre-graduation validated without a separate non-graduated transfer test.
No fixed block 0-3, follower-count, liq/FDV or turnover threshold may become production semantics from this candidate.
No workflow or code path may emit BUY, SELL, size, portfolio action, canonical promotion, budget change or self-merge.
